notes.note: Reviewed the bounded runtime-authentication delta and its callers: explicit auth codes still block; 429/rate-limit signals no longer enter the generic auth text fallback, so a proxy cooldown cannot create a durable sign-in failure or choose reconnect. Retained genuine auth failures clear only after a proven successful engine turn; guidance now names the engine Check connection smoke. This document makes no contrary claim about 429 classification or automatic auth recovery; its own interfaces, authority, and evidence qualifications remain accurate for this delta. Executed 202 focused connection-service, recovery-policy and auth-health tests, including the production cooldown text, durable restart, explicit-auth precedence and preservation of a genuine auth block. This is a delta review, not new platform, live-release or whole-document qualification.
